articles.summary: –4-year data from the Phase 1/2a open-label extension (OLE) studies support the potential disease-modifying effects of zorevunersen– –Improvements in cognition and behavior sustained through 4 years, in addition to durable seizure reductions and a generally well-tolerated safety profile– –New data
articles.title: Stoke Therapeutics and Biogen Announce Presentations of Clinical Data from Studies of Zorevunersen, an Investigational Medicine for the Treatment of Dravet Syndrome, at the 16th European Epilepsy Congress (EEC)
